subject: french
title: Daily Activities
welcome_lead: What you do every day in French.
meta_desc: KS3 French: daily routine verbs and activities.
final_note: Reflexive verbs power most daily routine talk.

walkthroughs.body_html: Morning routine: Je me leve (I get up). Je me lave (I wash). Je m'habille (I get dressed). These are reflexive verbs — action on yourself.
Je mange = I eat. Je vais a l'ecole = I go to school. Useful chunks for the start of your day.
Je me couche a vingt-deux heures = I go to bed at 10pm. French often uses the 24-hour clock for routine times.
